notes.title: Massive Update! 1/24
notes.notes:
Big Balance Changes

Tailored Loot: Equipment is more likely to have a stat that you want 
Reduced Healing: Enemy healing was way higher than it should be, it has been lowered
Enemy Difficulty: Enemy power level and health has been reduced at lower difficulty levels


New Features

Keybinds: You can now use 1-4 to cast abilities and space to end turn, optional visual indicators


Bug Fixes

Buffs/Debuffs: some displays were incorrect
Tutorial Saving: tutorials now save correctly
Retry: retry at a ? node now correctly restarts combat


Let us know what you think in the comments, discussion boards or on our Discord!
